decisions.statement: The picker counts the account again from the next ask.
An account no page is filed for is refused rather than made.
An account with no reason is answered as already standing.
The reason is cleared beside the page rather than in it.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
An account no page is filed for is a fault of the data.
Nothing here reads a token or asks a model.
